name: Arman Tsarukyan

face.shape: Long, fairly narrow oblong face. With the 2024-2026 full beard the lower face reads long and full; the 2019 photo (short beard) shows an angular jaw tapering to a medium chin.
face.jaw: Angular and moderately wide at the angles, but completely covered by a dense 3-5 cm beard in every recent photo. Build the jaw for a beard shell rather than sculpting it bare.
face.chin: Medium width and moderately long under the beard; the beard extends the visual chin about 3-4 cm below the bone and squares it off.
face.cheekbones: Moderately high and defined; the cheeks under them are lean and slightly flat at fight weight. The beard line starts just below the cheekbones.
face.brow_ridge: Moderately strong. The brows sit low on it, so the eyes look slightly deep-set.
face.forehead: Medium height, slightly low. Straight, dense hairline with gently rounded corners and no temple recession.

eyes.shape: Almond-shaped, medium size, outer corners level. The upper lids are partly hidden by the low brows; slight fullness under the lower lids.
eyes.spacing: Average, about one eye width apart.
eyes.colour: Medium warm brown, lighter amber around the pupil under studio flash (2026 portrait, UFC headshot). Closest embed iris: brownlight (brown also acceptable).

eyebrows.shape: Straight and close to horizontal, set low just above the eyes, tails tapering slightly down; medium gap between the brows.
eyebrows.colour: Very dark brown, almost black (similar to the hair, about #2a1d18).

nose.width: Narrow-to-medium bridge widening to moderately wide nostrils.
nose.bridge: Straight and fairly narrow in the front view, well projected.
nose.hump: None obvious; straight to very slightly convex in the September 2026 near-profile.
nose.tip: Defined, slightly rounded, pointing slightly downward.
nose.fight_damage: No visible deviation or flattening in these photos.

face.mouth: Medium width. Full lower lip, medium upper lip with a soft cupid's bow, pink-red. The moustache covers the upper-lip border.

ears.cauliflower: Yes, both ears: thickened, lumpy helix and antihelix. Clearest on his left ear in the UFC headshot and on his right ear in the 2024 interview. The ears sit slightly out from the head.

face.notable_marks_scars: No prominent scars visible. Post-fight bruising under both eyes in the April 2024 still (temporary).

hair.style: Thick hair, longer on top and swept up and back with a loose part and visible volume at the front; the sides and back are tapered short (scissor or clipper taper, not a skin fade). Slightly longer and pushed straight back at the September 2026 weigh-in.
hair.colour: Very dark brown, near black, warm; shows dark-chestnut highlights under strong light.
hair.hairline: Low-to-medium, straight, fully intact, rounded corners.

facial_hair.colour: Very dark brown to black, uniform; no grey visible.
facial_hair.density: Very dense and even from the cheekbone line down; neckline trimmed under the jaw.
facial_hair.length_mm: About 30-50 mm in 2024-2026 (longest at the chin); only about 8-12 mm in 2019.
facial_hair.shape: Full rounded beard joined to a full moustache, slightly squared at the bottom, natural cheek line set fairly high. Covers the jaw and chin completely.

skin.undertone: Warm, olive-golden; light-medium tone. Studio flash in both sampled portraits brightens it, so the true mid-tone in normal light is a little darker than tone_hex.
skin.freckles_marks: None visible. Moderate dark chest hair (centre of the chest and upper abdomen), dark hair on forearms and legs.
skin.texture_pick: young_caucasian_male tinted warmer and more olive toward tone_hex.

body.build: Compact, muscular and well proportioned lightweight with long arms for his height (reach 183 cm at 170 cm, about +13 cm ape index).
body.body_fat_notes: Clear six-pack and visible obliques in both studio stance photos and at the September 2026 weigh-in.
body.shoulders: Broad for his height, rounded deltoids, moderate trapezius.
body.chest: Well developed, square pectorals with moderate dark chest hair.
body.arms: Muscular and long; defined biceps and forearms.
body.legs: Muscular thighs, lean defined calves, dark leg hair.
body.posture: Upright with shoulders slightly forward and relaxed, chin level.
body.notable_physique_traits: Thick wrestler's neck, long reach, dark body hair.

tattoos_note: None visible on the torso, arms, legs or back in any of the photos (two full-body studio shots, a shirtless 2026 weigh-in, the 2026 singlet portrait).
accessories_seen: Silver chain necklace at the UFC 331 weigh-in; aviator sunglasses and clear glasses at fight-week media.

kit.typical_shorts: UFC/Venum fight shorts. Studio set 1 (about 2023-2024): red with dark-red and white tiger-claw stripes, black waistband with white UFC logo, and the Venum logo and a yellow "TSA..." name on his left hip and thigh. Studio set 2 (2025-2026): black with a tonal dark-grey geometric print and the crypto.com logo. UFC 331 weigh-in (Sept 2026): black waistband with red panels. Reports mention custom "Batman"-themed shorts for UFC 331 that are not visible in these photos. Red wrestling singlet in the July 2026 portrait.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Estimates in case standard MakeHuman ear modifiers are added.

render_hints.eyebrows: the thicker of eyebrow001/eyebrow010, tinted #2a1d18, set low and straight
render_hints.hair: a short proxy with volume on top (short02 or short04), tinted #2d1f1a; sides tapered, not shaved
render_hints.beard: full beard shell 3-5 cm deep at the chin, colour #261b18; it defines the lower-face silhouette

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, eyes, skin and physique; medium for face proportions because the jaw and chin are hidden under the beard in every photo since 2024; low-to-medium for exact morph values. 9 photos (1 embed-ok: the reviewed CC BY 2024 interview still; 8 reference-only, incl. the 2019 Commons still whose YouTube CC BY claim is still awaiting licence review and the 2026 Commons file with a doubtful own-work claim); 4 are from 2026. No clean true profile exists: the best are two September 2026 weigh-in shots (one about 80 degrees but with a fist under the chin, one from behind). What to watch: (1) the beard is the main silhouette cue: a long, dense, rounded full beard; without it he will not read as him. (2) Low, thick, straight brows over medium-brown eyes. (3) Long straight nose. (4) Thick swept-up hair with volume, not a fade. (5) Lean and muscular with long arms; no tattoos at all.

changes: Re-checked every photo: hair, full beard, brows, eyes, nose, cauliflower ears, no tattoos, physique and kit descriptions are supported by the photos; skin samples re-sampled and consistent.
wm-2019-infocus.jpg downgraded to reference-only: its YouTube CC BY claim is still pending Commons licence review.
Corrected the 2019 hair note in sources.json (faded short crop, not side-parted).
Morph names all exist in assets/embed/mh-manifest.json; all values are within 0..1.

stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 from his documented fighting style: data/scouting/arman-tsarukyan.json (archetype, tags, signature and summary) and widely described stance traits. The ESPN stance cutouts (espn-stance-left.png, espn-stance-right.png) are posed standing shots, so they were used only for posture, shoulder set and build, not for the guard or footwork; fight footage would sharpen these values.
stance.notes: Wrestle-boxer: slightly wide, bent-knee stance ready to shoot, level-change feints.
